policy: Aliases are permitted only in named adapters, migrations, and compatibility shims. Canonical serialization uses canonical terms.

terms.rule: The scenario is the complete immutable input, not an engine config object.
Use building for the physical building container.
A dwelling is geometry; household state is not a synonym.
Canonical thermal entities and IDs use zone and zone_id.
Canonical human entities and IDs use occupant and occupant_id.
An action is an instruction or intent, not proof of execution.
An event is an immutable occurrence with a timestep and identity.
A command is requested; it must remain distinct from actual system state.
System state is actual constrained mode, flow, power, or actuator position.
Physical state contains evolved physical quantities, not behavior-facing projections.
An observation is an explicitly selected or transformed view of physical state.
The canonical index is zero-based and distinct from the simulation clock.
The clock is the timestamp derived from period start and fixed timestep duration.
The complete ordered series contains one weather state per timestep.
The period defines start, timezone, fixed dt_minutes, and n_timesteps.
